paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: Accuracy of Llama4 Scout (top) and Llama4 Maverick (bottom) on 5-digit multiplication.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between initial confidence and various accuracy measurements. The x-axis is labeled "Initial Confidence" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.95 to 0.99 with tick labels at intervals of 0.01. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy", also on a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 with tick labels every 0.2 units. The "Final Acc" line is blue with circular markers and a solid line style. It starts at the value of approximately 0.9 at 0.95 initial confidence, shows a slight increase peaking around 0.98 initial confidence at about 0.96, then slightly decreases towards the end. The "Δ Acc" line is orange with diamond markers and a dashed line style. It begins near 0.9, follows a similar pattern of slight increase towards 0.98, and ends near 0.89 at 0.99 initial confidence. Lastly, the "Initial Acc" line is green with square markers and a dash-dot line style, starting just above 0.0, exhibiting a gradual increase across the range, and finally finishing at 0.15 at 0.99 initial Acc. The blue line overlapped the orange dashed line from the start until 0.97 initial confidence. There are error bars with every tick label on the line plot indicating variability uncertainty. There is a legend available on top of the plot to map different line styles to their labels.
